title: ReadOnBranchResponse
description: The commit the files were read at, each file's text, or no text when the commit holds no such file, and the files under the folders asked for. The kernel records this answer, so a script that called for it reads the same texts when its calls are replayed.

commit.description: The commit the worktree was cut at, in full.

files.description: One entry for each path asked for, in its order.

text.description: The file's text; left out when the commit holds no such file.

listed.description: The files under the folders asked for in list, relative to the project, sorted, at most 2000; left out when no folder was asked for.

listedCut.description: True when the folders hold more files than listed holds; left out when no folder was asked for.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.
